methodological_rigor.justification: Retrospective cohort with appropriate group comparisons and statistical testing. Cox regression for survival analysis. Limitations include single-center design and retrospective selection bias.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Individual cohort study (LoE 2b) demonstrating clinical outcomes in specific patient population. Direct relevance to treatment selection.

reporting_quality.justification: STROBE-aligned reporting with clear outcome definitions. Statistical methods specified. No repository deposition.

novelty_literature.justification: Retrospective confirmation of known outcomes. Limited novel contribution.

writing_presentation.justification: Clear presentation with adequate methods and results sections.

chief_reviewer.rationale: Moderate quality retrospective cohort. Appropriate for Tier 3 conditional on prospective external validation.
